sea_ad_mtg_20k.title: SEA-AD MTG 20K subsample (raw)
sea_ad_mtg_20k.description: Allen Institute SEA-AD Middle Temporal Gyrus, 20K cells, snRNA-seq. X is log-normalised; raw UMI counts are in layers['UMIs']. 24 subclasses.

adult_cortex_multiome_rna.title: Adult Mouse Cortex Multiome RNA (P57)
adult_cortex_multiome_rna.description: 17,412-cell integrated scRNA-seq from mouse cortex, Multiome RNA. 5 batches, annotated cell types. X is scaled (has negative values); raw UMI counts are in layers['raw'], log-normalised in layers['log1p'].
adult_cortex_multiome_rna.reference: Bravo González-Blas et al. Nat Methods 20, 1355-1367 (2023)

mouse_brain_10k_gemx.title: 10K Mouse Brain GEM-X v4 (10x Genomics)
mouse_brain_10k_gemx.description: CellRanger-filtered feature-barcode matrix. 11,357 cells, 33,696 genes. Single-sample RNA preprocessing tutorial.

e18_v3_cell.title: E18 Mouse Brain Neurons 10K v3 (10x Genomics)
e18_v3_cell.description: CellRanger-filtered feature-barcode matrix. E18 mouse brain neurons, Chromium v3 chemistry. Multi-sample tutorial sample 1 of 3.

e18_v3_nuclei.title: E18 Mouse Brain Nuclei 5K v3.1 (10x Genomics)
e18_v3_nuclei.description: CellRanger-filtered feature-barcode matrix. E18 mouse brain nuclei, Next GEM v3.1 chemistry. Multi-sample tutorial sample 2 of 3.

e18_v4_cell.title: E18 Mouse Neurons 10K GEM-X v4 (10x Genomics)
e18_v4_cell.description: CellRanger-filtered feature-barcode matrix. E18 mouse neurons, GEM-X v4 chemistry. Multi-sample tutorial sample 3 of 3.

pbmc_multiome_san1.title: Human PBMC snMultiome SAN1 (De Rop 2024)
pbmc_multiome_san1.description: CellRanger-filtered feature-barcode matrix, snMultiome RNA, SAN1 sample. 3,545 cells, 36,601 genes.
pbmc_multiome_san1.reference: De Rop et al. Nat Biotechnol 42, 916-926 (2024)

pbmc_multiome_san2.title: Human PBMC snMultiome SAN2 (De Rop 2024)
